app.brandTagline: The resume that puts feelings into words.
app.title: A resume that speaks from the heart.
app.subtitle: Your story, your strengths and your way of loving, laid out like a real resume. Ready to print, no account needed.
app.disclaimer: Be kind: never share personal contact details.
app.exportHint: Opens the print dialog: choose “Save as PDF”.

privacy.publicNotice: Everything appears in the preview and PDF, including first names.
privacy.semiPrivateNotice: History and reviews stay, but first names become “Someone” in the preview and PDF.
privacy.privateNotice: History and reviews are removed from the preview and PDF; profile, traits, values and skills stay.

profile.title: The essentials
profile.subtitle: The foundations of your resume, in a few fields.
profile.rolePlaceholder: E.g. Curious partner, reliable and a little goofy
profile.bioPlaceholder: What makes you unique in love…
profile.bioHint: 2 to 4 sentences. Swear words are masked automatically.
profile.privacyHint: This setting changes the PDF content, not access rights: once exported, the file can be shared.

traits.title: Your strengths
traits.subtitle: The words that feel like you, and what matters most.
traits.confirmDeleteBody: “{{value}}” will be removed from your resume.
traits.confirmResetBody: All traits and values will be removed.

relationships.title: Your love story
relationships.subtitle: A few landmarks, no intimate details. You choose what stays visible.
relationships.draftHint: Only a first name is required. Dates and the reason are optional.
relationships.reasonPlaceholder: E.g. We grew in two different directions.
relationships.confirmDeleteBody: “{{name}}” will be removed from your resume.

references.title: What people say
references.subtitle: One sincere review beats a long list of qualities.
references.draftHint: A first name and a few words are enough. Swear words are masked.
references.quotePlaceholder: E.g. Always there to listen, even when I repeat the same story.
references.confirmDeleteBody: {{name}}’s review will be removed from your resume.

skills.title: Your relationship skills
skills.subtitle: What you bring, without false modesty.
skills.confirmDeleteBody: “{{name}}” will be removed from your resume.

privacyLegend.title: Privacy
privacyLegend.subtitle: Each mode changes the preview and PDF content, not access rights.
privacyLegend.publicDescription: Name, history and reviews are displayed, including first names.
privacyLegend.semiPrivateDescription: History and reviews stay; first names become “Someone”.
privacyLegend.privateDescription: History and reviews disappear; profile, traits, values and skills stay.

preview.title: Live preview
preview.subtitle: What people will see when they receive your PDF.
preview.defaultBio: Two or three sentences are enough to make people want to know more.
preview.emptyHint: Start with your name in the form.
preview.privateBody: History and reviews are hidden by your privacy setting.

onboarding.firstTitle: A love resume, without the fuss
onboarding.firstBody: Start with your name. Everything is saved in this browser, with no account and nothing sent.
onboarding.exampleBody: Edit it freely, or start over whenever you like.
onboarding.replaceBody: Loading the example will replace what you have already written.
onboarding.clearBody: The fields and the local save will be removed. This cannot be undone.
onboarding.localBody: Automatic local saving, no server. You can clear everything in one click.

export.success: Print window opened. Choose “Save as PDF”.
export.error: Could not open printing. Try again from your browser.
export.nameRequired: Add your name before printing the PDF.
export.exampleBody: This is an example: replace the names and details with yours before sharing.

footer.privacyBody: Your answers stay in your browser. No account, no server storage.
footer.analytics: Anonymous audience measurement by Vercel Analytics, without cookies.
footer.disclaimer: Be kind: never share personal contact details.
footer.rights: LoveResume — a resume for fun, to share with the consent of the people mentioned.

example.role: Curious partner, reliable and a little goofy
example.bio: I love long conversations, Sundays without an alarm and people who laugh at their own jokes. I’m looking for someone to build something simple and solid with, full of tenderness and a little chaos.

relationship.reason: We grew in two different directions.

reference.name: Nina
reference.quote: Always there to listen, even when I repeat the same story.
